description: Listed building consent for the conversion of offices into eight self contained flats
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38, 40, Heritage Statement, Design & Access Statement received 5 February 2021; Energy Statement received 10 May 2021; Internal Average Daylight Study received 14 June 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Details in respect of the following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the relevant work is begun. The relevant work shall be carried out in accordance with such approved details.

Condition : 5 - All existing architectural features including staircases, balustrades, windows, doors, architraves, skirtings, dados, picture rails, panel work, fireplaces, tiling, corbelled arches, cornices, decorative ceilings and other decorative features shall be retained except where otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.
For the avoidance of doubt, fixing points for any handrail or railing into any part of the existing building shall be kept at a minimum and shall be made into the mortar joints between the stones using non-ferrous fixings; where this is required, full details of these fixings shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Planning Authority prior to any works on site.
